items.claim: Tai Miller is very patient and landed 59 significant strikes in round one against Fugat.
items.quote: very very patient and wow, 59 significant strikes landed in round one.

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff is giving up a lot in the reach department against Tai Miller.
items.quote: he's given up a lot in the reach department.

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff's durability is not all that great.
items.quote: I don't think he's his durability is all that great.

items.claim: Tai Miller has a massive size advantage and knows how to use his boxing.
items.quote: He's got massive size advantage here and he knows how to use that, you know, that boxing that he's got.

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff fights recklessly in so many of his fights.
items.quote: Billy Gooff kind of comes out there and just fights so recklessly in so many of his fights

items.claim: Tai Miller is a fit NHB guy under Tom Vaughn who works well with long rangy strikers.
items.quote: he's a fit NHB guy under Tom Vaughn. Tom Vaughn knows what to do with these long rangy strikers

items.claim: Tai Miller has a beautiful left hand down the pipe, elbows, and knees up the middle.
items.quote: He's got a beautiful left hand down the pipe. He's got elbows. He's got knees up the middle.

items.claim: Tai Miller is able to keep up high volume and pace himself excellently through 15 minutes.
items.quote: Miller's able to keep up high volume. He's able to pace himself excellent through the 15 minutes.

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff hardly fights at all, which suggests he must have injuries.
items.quote: he must have injuries cuz he hardly fights at all.
